description: One self-hosted Kadmo AI agent in a Kubernetes cluster you control - the kadmo-agent image as a one-replica StatefulSet that installs the agent from your Kadmo app on its first boot.

OpenSearch Operator: run OpenSearch clusters and OpenSearch Dashboards from OpenSearchCluster custom resources, with rolling upgrades, scaling, security configuration and TLS. The CRDs ship with the chart. Hardened by QuenchWorks: the operator is built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed…

Redis Operator (OT-CONTAINER-KIT): run Redis standalone, replication, Sentinel and Redis Cluster from Kubernetes resources. The CRDs ship with the chart. Hardened by QuenchWorks: the operator is built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
